methodologyNotes: Pricing fetched directly from each vendor's official /pricing page using WebFetch on 2026-06-14. Reply.io returned HTTP 403; pricing sourced from GetApp listing (getapp.com/sales-software/a/reply/pricing/) as fallback, corroborated by a second GetApp fetch. Woodpecker uses pure usage-based pricing with no named flat tiers; the plan recorded reflects their stated base of $4.80/100 contacted prospects/month. Mailshake GetApp listing showed older prices ($59/$99); official page prices ($29/$49/$99) are used as authoritative. Saleshandy official page accessed twice and showed $36/$99/$199/$299 monthly rates — used as authoritative. annualDiscountPct is computed from the annualized monthly rate vs the stated monthly rate where both were published. monthlyUsd for annually-billed plans reflects the per-month equivalent of the annual commitment. All telephony fields (minutesIncluded, callsIncluded, overagePerMin, overagePerCall) are null throughout as this is a non-telephony vertical.
